intent: Add a public static method get_supported_method_ids() to the Woodev_Test_Shipping_Labels class in includes/class-woodev-test-shipping-labels.php. It returns an array of the shipping method ids that get_label() knows about ('courier' and 'pickup'), in that order. Document it with a WordPress-style docblock. Do not change get_label() or any other file.
rationale: The baseline case: ordinary, well-specified new work on a file the profile's phpcs gate really runs against. If this does not commit, the harness is not a development tool at all -- every catching-power number after it would be measuring a system nobody could use. It also exercises the line-scoped phpcs gate on a genuinely-added method, which is the path that made a legacy file workable in s51.
